findings.description: F006 says the base_ref is explicit and recorded, but it does not pin how the correct base is selected or validated for create <plan-id>. Recording the chosen base is not enough if the command can accidentally use the caller's current checkout or an implicit default.
findings.recommendation: Define the base_ref source and precedence, require resolvability before worktree creation, and add a test proving creation from a non-current base uses the recorded base rather than ambient HEAD.

findings.description: The objective directive requires lock/build/close to record the binding, but F002 covers lock/audit/close and never mentions build. If build is a real gate or mutating command, this leaves a named contract path without binding evidence.
findings.recommendation: Add build to the binding snapshot capture contract and tests, or explicitly mark build as nonexistent or out of scope for this v0.

findings.description: F002 makes plan audit write binding evidence, but F003 does not protect plan audit with the wrong-worktree guard. That permits a session outside the bound worktree to mutate plan evidence while lock, close, and disposition are refused.
findings.recommendation: Either include audit in the guarded command set or state why audit evidence mutation is intentionally allowed from any checkout and test that behavior.

findings.description: The objective says merge/close operates from the plan worktree, but no proposed feature names a merge path or proves merge-equivalent behavior is guarded. Disposition may be intended to cover this, but the plan does not say so.
findings.recommendation: Add merge to the guarded command matrix, or explicitly map disposition to the merge operation and test refusal, override recording, and bound-worktree execution.

findings.description: F007 validates the dashboard state payload, but the user-facing contract says the dashboard shows active worktrees. A payload block alone does not prove the dashboard UI actually renders branch, dirty state, untracked count, actor, and broken bindings.
findings.recommendation: Add the dashboard renderer or component wiring to F007 acceptance, with a test or fixture that exercises the visible dashboard output from the payload.
